text:
maria: Quick async check — final gate for promoting kite-4b-v2 to staging. Need confirmations on: weights location + checksum, tokenizer quirks (special tokens), config lint (batching/kv cache), and a quick golden/toolcall smoke. tagging @aj @tanvi for ops.

aj: Weights uploaded to S3: `s3://redwood-models/kite/4b/v2/weights.tar.gz` (artifact: kite-4b-v2-20260315.tar). SHA256 in PR #342: `3f2b...a9c1`. Permissions OK for staging role.

tanvi: tokenizer export had a stray control token `"<|eo|>"` mapped to id 50256. I added a compatibility mapping in `tokenizer.json` to map it to ``"</s>"`` for toolcall flows. Snippet:```json
{"special_tokens_mapping": {"<|eo|>": "</s>"}}
```Apply this to the runtime tokenizer before running goldens.

ci-bot: preflight results: unit tests 185/185 passed. smoke-toolcall job FAILED (1/4 structured-toolcall cases). See logs: https://ci.redwood/kite/342/logs. Rerun with `CI_DEBUG=1` to get full trace.

leo: I reproduced the toolcall failure locally — structured output missing the `tools` array when prompt triggers calc path. Quick patch: ensure fallback in prompt template: `"tools": tools or []`. Example:```js
const payload = { prompt, tools: (toolsList && toolsList.length) ? toolsList : [] }
```That fixed the missing field for me.

maria: thanks — can someone run the golden regression with tanvi's tokenizer mapping + leo's prompt fallback so we have a clean signal? I can kick off but want confirmation this is the correct combo to test. :rocket:

aj: approved. I'll start the run from the S3 artifact and patch the tokenizer mapping in the job. Run id: `kite-4b-v2-reg-20260315-1`. Estimated 12m.

sre-oncall: FYI dedicated staging pool has headroom for a smoke burst. Watch tail latency — if p95 > 450ms, abort canary. I'll monitor. :eyes:

tanvi: small note: if any integration relies on token ids rather than text labels, set `force_token_ids=false` in the tokenizer loader to avoid mismatches.

maria: copied. Plan: 1) run reg (aj) 2) check structured-toolcall golden prompts (maria/leo) 3) if green, 10% canary in staging tomorrow morning. I'll update the rollout doc after results.

ci-bot: REG run `kite-4b-v2-reg-20260315-1` finished: 197/200 checks passed. 3 failures are structured-output mismatches (deltas in tools array ordering). Linked issues: https://triage/kite/256, https://triage/kite/257.

maria: OK great progress — will triage the 3 mismatches in the morning, but not blocking canary (they are ordering-only). Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
